column7: Typo – You may consider to make this a Global Correction using the target search: " ddaś"  ——becomes—–  " dṛś" • the initial space in the target search " ddaś" is required to avoid ativyāpti, which I am sure will delight Andhrabharati, by my mention. The form: " ddaś" in every single occurrence can only be this: " dṛś" – There is no other possible correct combination of these letters.
